module.purpose: Provides TypeScript utility types for extracting value, argument, and result types from atom type definitions, enabling type-safe state management patterns.
module.summary: This file contains type utilities for working with atom-based state management. It exports conditional types that extract the value type from an Atom, the write arguments from a WritableAtom, and the result type from a WritableAtom. Additionally, it derives Getter and Setter types from the method signatures of Atom and WritableAtom respectively, and provides a SetStateAction type for representing state update functions. All types are designed to work with the atom types imported from './atom.ts'.
module.businessContext: Enables type-safe atom-based state management by inferring correct types from atom definitions. If this file fails, developers lose compile-time type checking for state operations, leading to runtime errors and reduced developer productivity.

moduleLayout: import type { Atom, PrimitiveAtom, WritableAtom } from './atom.ts'
export type Setter = Parameters<WritableAtom<unknown, unknown[], unknown>['write']>[1]
export type ExtractAtomValue<AtomType> = AtomType extends Atom<infer Value> ? Value : never
export type ExtractAtomArgs<AtomType> = AtomType extends WritableAtom<unknown, infer Args, infer _Result> ? Args : never
export type ExtractAtomResult<AtomType> = AtomType extends WritableAtom<unknown, infer _Args, infer Result> ? Result : never
